Knowledge: Who you are and who you know: a key of your own, meeting people, introducing them.
Friendship: Friends: become friends by agreeing, and end a friendship.
Guardians: Wards: agents a person creates and looks after, who act only through their guardians.
Agents: AI agents with an accountable developer and an accountable owner.
Provenance-Groups: Forwarding with provenance: every forward adds a signature you can see.
Children: A social network safe for children: parents, kids-only groups, coming of age.
Feeds: Feeds and followers, delivered from friend to friend.
Overlay: Pointing: each person points to some of their friends, and to people those friends point to.
Forwarding: Forwarding items with provenance: whoever passes an item on signs it.
Programs: Programs passed from friend to friend: publishing, trusting developers, installing and inviting.
AppStore: The app store: a developer whose agent runs on a server and offers the programs it holds.
Rendezvous: Rendezvous: friends far apart find each other again through a rendezvous server.
Encounters: Meeting in person: phones near each other, over Bluetooth or the local network, become friends.
Directory: A directory: find people by their email address, and get the link to reach them.
Services: Services: a ward run by a machine at an address everyone can reach, as a rendezvous server, a directory and a store are.
Agora: Barter: make things, post them on a market wall, trade them.
Coins: Personal currencies: everyone can issue their own coins.
Bonds: Bonds with maturity dates, and escrow, on top of coins.
